prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.)
text: I was turning left at a green light when a silver pickup truck came through the intersection from the opposite direction and struck the front passenger side of my vehicle. I had already started into the turn and was moving slowly, so I did not have time to react. The impact spun my car partly around and pushed it toward the curb. I stayed in my seat until the airbags settled, then got out and checked on the other driver, who said he was fine. Officers arrived and filed a report at the scene. My neck and upper back began hurting within an hour, and I was diagnosed with whiplash the following day. I have been attending physical therapy since then and am still experiencing stiffness and headaches. My vehicle is currently at the repair shop awaiting an estimate.
